    ConceptRef - Interface in network.ike.knowledge.spi
    A concept reference as written in a POM or ViewSpec — the three forms of the IKE-KNOWLEDGE-VIEW reference grammar (IKE-Network/ike-issues#849, #851): uuid:<uuid>[,<uuid>...] — exact identity; a list, because public ids are UUID sets (ConceptRef.Uuids); <BindingsClass>#<CONSTANT> or bare #<CONSTANT> — a bindings-class constant, resolved by reflective static-field read on the implementation side; with no class named, the implementation's default bindings class applies (override per spec via ViewSpec.REFS_DEFAULT_BINDING_CLASS) (ConceptRef.Binding); text:<name> or any other bare string — a description text, resolved as a unique live fully qualified or regular name against the store; ambiguity or no-match fails the build (ConceptRef.Text).
    ConceptRef.Binding - Record Class in network.ike.knowledge.spi
    A bindings-class constant reference, resolved implementation-side by reflective static-field read.
    ConceptRef.Text - Record Class in network.ike.knowledge.spi
    A description-text reference, resolved as a unique live fully qualified or regular name against the store.
    ConceptRef.Uuids - Record Class in network.ike.knowledge.spi
    An exact-identity reference: one or more UUIDs forming the public id.
